description: This file defines the SocialMessagingClient class within the Aws\SocialMessaging namespace. It serves as a client for interacting with the AWS End User Messaging Social service, providing method annotations for various operations such as associating WhatsApp Business accounts, managing message media, and tagging resources.

classes.name: SocialMessagingClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS SocialMessaging service, extends AwsClient.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Associates a WhatsApp Business Account with the service.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of associating a WhatsApp Business Account.

methods.name: deleteWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Deletes media associated with a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: deleteWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of deleting WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: disassociateWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Disassociates a WhatsApp Business Account.

methods.name: disassociateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of disassociating WhatsApp Business Account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Retrieves linked WhatsApp Business Account details.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of getting linked WhatsApp Business Account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumber
methods.description: Gets the phone number linked to the WhatsApp Business Account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of getting linked WhatsApp Business Account phone number.

methods.name: getWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Retrieves media for a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: getWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of retrieving WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: listLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccounts
methods.description: Lists all linked WhatsApp Business Accounts.

methods.name: listLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of listing linked accounts.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of listing resource tags.

methods.name: postWhatsAppMessageMedia
methods.description: Uploads media for WhatsApp messages.

methods.name: postWhatsAppMessageMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of uploading WhatsApp message media.

methods.name: putWhatsAppBusinessAccountEventDestinations
methods.description: Sets event destinations for WhatsApp Business Accounts.

methods.name: putWhatsAppBusinessAccountEventDestinationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of setting event destinations.

methods.name: sendWhatsAppMessage
methods.description: Sends a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: sendWhatsAppMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of sending a WhatsApp message.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of tagging a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of untagging a resource.
